name: prompt-router
description: Prompt Router: a Claude Code mod that routes each prompt to this chat, a subagent or a new session, with the right model and effort. This marketplace installs the Claude Code mod; the OpenCode adapter lives in the repo (see README)

plugins.name: prompt-router
plugins.description: Routes each prompt to this chat, a subagent or a new session, picks the model and effort, sets effort here by itself and has Claude ask before moving work elsewhere
